subject: MSA / Order Form - Support schedule, uptime bands & credit model
messages:
From: Morgan Price <morgan.price@acme.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Acme Procurement <procurement@acme.com>
Date: Sun, 21 Jun 2026 08:14:00 -0700
Subject: Proposed redlines - uptime bands and credits

Jonas / Marissa,

Thanks for the call this morning. As requested, attached are our redlines to the MSA and the draft order form sections dealing with uptime targets, support response windows, and service credit calculations. High level asks from Acme: keep a clear banded uptime metric (99.9 / 99.5 / <99.5), preserve a 72-hour maintenance notification minimum, and cap credits at 50% of monthly fees.

A few specifics we flagged in the attached PDF:
- Need clarity on measurement window (we prefer rolling 30-day).
- Credits should be automatic after verification, not subject to manual claims.
- Response SLA: critical incidents = 1 hour ack and 4 hour mitigation target.

We copied procurement and legal on this thread; would like to get to a mutually agreeable draft by next Wednesday.

Attachments: redline_MSA_v3.pdf, support_sla_matrix.xlsx

Morgan Price
Director, IT Procurement
Acme Corporation

From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
To: Morgan Price <morgan.price@acme.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 21 Jun 2026 11:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Proposed redlines - uptime bands and credits

Morgan — thanks for sending this over and for the clear asks. I reviewed the redlines and attached an initial counter-proposal in the support_sla_matrix.xlsx that maps uptime bands to the credit % we can accept and the verification steps. Key points from our side:

- Measurement window: we can agree to a 30-day rolling window, but need to exclude scheduled maintenance windows as defined in an annex (propose separate maintenance_schedule.csv).
- Automatic credits: we can automate net-of-billing credits for the standard availability bands, but for any credit >25% we request a short review window (5 business days) to validate telemetry and root cause. This is to avoid accidental over-crediting from false positives.
- Response definitions: we accept 1 hour ack for critical; however, mitigation ETA is product-specific. We propose "initial mitigation" within 4 hours and "workaround or restore" target within 48 hours for infrastructure incidents.

I've attached the matrix and a draft maintenance annex. Can Marissa and Lauren review the language on the credit governance and the maintenance notification timing? If procurement wants automation for credits we can include a runbook for reconciliation.

Jonas Weber
Director, Enterprise Sales | Redwood Inference
Phone: +1 415-555-0157
Attachments: support_sla_matrix.xlsx, maintenance_schedule.csv

> On Sun, Jun 21, 2026 at 08:14 AM Morgan Price <morgan.price@acme.com> wrote:
> > Jonas / Marissa,
> >
> > Thanks for the call this morning....

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>, Morgan Price <morgan.price@acme.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 22 Jun 2026 09:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Proposed redlines - uptime bands and credits

Looping in a couple of quick commercial suggestions:

- For the credit cap, let's propose a stepped cap: 25% cap for single-event credits, 50% cap aggregated monthly. This helps us avoid bill shocks while giving Acme meaningful protection.
- On the 72-hour maintenance notification, we can do 72 business hours for rolling maintenance (planned patching). For emergency maintenance (e.g., security hotfix) we will notify as soon as possible and provide post-facto documentation.
- Recommend we include a short SLA Exceptions section: force majeure, customer-induced outages, and third-party infra failures (public cloud region outages).

If legal (Lauren) is OK with the governance around automated credits with a 5-business-day validation hold above 25%, I can circulate a clean order form for signature.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Strategic Sales | Redwood Inference

From: Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@vertexlegal.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>, Morgan Price <morgan.price@acme.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 23 Jun 2026 10:42:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Proposed redlines - uptime bands and credits

Marissa / Jonas / Morgan — Vertex Legal reviewed the redlines and the counter matrix. A couple of legal redlines we suggest: 

1) "Verification" clause: specify the metrics/source of truth (Redwood telemetry + agreed instrumentation tags). Recommend referencing a defined telemetry endpoint and giving both parties read-only access for the 30-day sliding window.

2) "Maintenance" definition: define "Scheduled Maintenance" as events with an announced start window and maximum duration, and limit how often Redwood may schedule >4 hour maintenance in a 90-day window without compensating credits. This prevents indefinite long maintenance windows.

3) "Credit governance": fine to automate credits but include an audit clause that allows either party to request an audit within 30 days of credit posting. Also recommend a shorter dispute window (10 business days) once credits are posted.

I've added inline edits in redline_MSA_v3.pdf and a short legal note in support_sla_matrix.xlsx (tab: legal_comments). If you want, we can convert the maintenance definition into a short annex that lists blackout windows and a regular maintenance cadence.

Samantha Lee
Senior Counsel, Vertex Legal (external counsel for Acme)

From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
To: Morgan Price <morgan.price@acme.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>, Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@vertexlegal.com>
Date: Thu, 24 Jun 2026 16:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Proposed redlines - uptime bands and credits

Thanks everyone — constructive feedback and very helpful. Proposed next steps: 

1) Lauren, can your team incorporate Samantha's telemetry/source-of-truth language and the audit window into the MSA annex?
2) Marissa and I will revise the support_sla_matrix.xlsx to reflect the stepped-cap approach (25% single event / 50% monthly aggregate) and add the 5-business-day validation hold for credits >25%.
3) Morgan / Acme procurement: if that looks okay, we'll generate a clean order form and send a DocuSign package (link below) with the MSA redlines and the annex attached. We propose the following timeline: legal sign-off by next Tue (6/29), DocuSign out by 6/30, signature by 7/6.

Docs: https://hubspot.company/deal/ACME-DEAL-2026-07 (deal record)
DocuSign draft: https://docusign.com/ABC-ACME

If procurement wants us to waive the 5-business-day validation hold for credits >25% in exchange for a stronger telemetry access arrangement (read-only dashboards + weekly digest), we're open to that trade.

I'll prepare the clean OF once Lauren confirms the annex language.

Best,
Jonas Weber
Director, Enterprise Sales | Redwood Inference
Phone: +1 415-555-0157
